Server boundary and observation (outside session ownership)
|
|-- SessionHandler (server/src/handlers/session.ts)
|   `-- request handlers -> Session.Service; submission does not own run
|-- Snapshot reads -> Session.get / messages / inbox -> projected state
|-- Historical log -> Session.log -> Bus.log ordered aggregate history
|   `-- historical replay requires retained event payloads
`-- EventFeed (server/src/event-feed.ts)
    |-- observes Bus.listen; Bus.subscribe also offers volatile live events
    |-- subscriber map -> bounded queues -> encoded SSE frames
    |   `-- slow subscriber fails on overflow (default capacity 4096)
    `-- disconnect releases subscriber, not session execution
